- Next step we agreed: 30-minute product intro showing architecture, routing/fallback, and suggested cost controls.

To make scheduling easy, can you pick two preferred windows from the three below (we'll lock the one that fits your team):

Option A (priority): Thu Dec 10 — 10:00–10:30 PT / 13:00–13:30 ET
Option B (priority): Thu Dec 10 — 15:00–15:30 PT / 18:00–18:30 ET
Option C (backup): Fri Dec 11 — 09:00–09:30 PT / 12:00–12:30 ET

If none of these work, tell me two 30-minute bands that do and I can send an invite. Attendees from our side will be me (sales), Irene (solutions), and Priyom (technical AE) who can cover deployment/quantization questions.

I've attached a 1‑page prep agenda and a short checklist for the demo (prep-agenda.pdf). If you have any specific scenarios or success criteria you want us to cover, drop them here and we'll surface them in the walkthrough.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
